label: Google
description: Google Gemini API key and Gemini CLI coding agent. After Install, Google appears under Settings → LLMs → Providers & Keys, and Gemini CLI under Coding Agents.

steps.title: Open Google
steps.body: Press the Google row in this table. The page slides open so you can paste a key or use Gemini CLI.

steps.title: API key or Gemini CLI
steps.body: Paste your Google Gemini API key here. No key? Skip this and use Gemini CLI on this same slide.

steps.title: Test & Save
steps.body: Press Test & Save after you paste a key. Using Gemini CLI without a key? Press Skip.

steps.title: Gemini CLI
steps.body: Gemini CLI is Google's coding agent. Detect finds the CLI. Keep it on to pick Gemini CLI in chat.
